name: GeneratedChandelier
prompt: One monumental Gothic cathedral chandelier, an intact single hanging prop: two thick wrought-iron crown rings, twelve substantial candle cups with ivory wax candles, pointed Gothic tracery and connected forged scroll arms. Three sturdy suspension chains join a central top eye. Oxidized dark iron, aged bronze details, realistic soot and wax. Complete detailed underside, thick connected structure, four-meter diameter, no fabric lampshade. Isolated object only; no room, floor, pedestal, people, text, logos, flames or fog.
